How to Upset the Current Bid
Visit the Clerk of Court's Office – Civil Division and provide the file number for the property on which you wish to place an upset bid.  Please note that the Clerk's Office accepts cash or certified funds only. Personal checks will not be accepted.

PLEASE CONTACT THE RUTHERFORD COUNTY CLERK OF COURT FOR THE MOST UP TO DATE INFORMATION CONCERNING UPSET BIDS 1-828-288-6100
Other County surplus properties and equipment may be available. 
Please check our GovDeals page for more information.
